landingPage.heroDescription: A full-stack application for tracking development cycles using the Shape Up methodology by Basecamp. Features AI-powered risk analysis, interactive hill charts, and comprehensive team collaboration tools.
landingPage.featuresTitle: Everything You Need for Shape Up
landingPage.featuresDesc: From cycle planning to risk analysis, ShipFlow provides all the tools your team needs to implement Shape Up successfully.
landingPage.cycleManagementDesc: Create and manage 6-week development cycles with betting and building phases following Shape Up methodology.
landingPage.hillChartsDesc: Visual progress tracking showing work moving from "figuring it out" to "making it happen" with drag-and-drop.
landingPage.aiRiskAnalysisDesc: Get AI-powered risk assessments with actionable insights and smart recommendations for your pitches.
landingPage.pitchHealthDesc: Lightweight dashboard with risk-colored cards, budget progress, and QA status at a glance.
landingPage.teamManagementDesc: Organize teams, assign tasks, track time, and collaborate with pair programming support.
landingPage.retrospectivesDesc: Run team retros with voting and merging. Cycles can't close until retrospectives are complete.
landingPage.aiQADesc: Generate test cases with AI, execute test suites, track coverage, and maintain quality with integrated bug reporting.
landingPage.accessibleDesc: Full keyboard navigation, screen reader support, high contrast, and focus indicators for all users.
landingPage.howItWorksDesc: Shape Up is a product development methodology created by Basecamp that gives teams more autonomy and focuses on shipping meaningful work.
landingPage.step1Desc: Senior people work on shaping pitches - defining the problem, setting boundaries, and outlining a solution.
landingPage.step2Desc: Leadership reviews shaped pitches at the betting table and decides which ones to commit to.
landingPage.step3Desc: Small teams work autonomously to build and ship within the fixed time appetite.
landingPage.step4Desc: Two weeks for bug fixes, technical debt, and exploring new ideas before the next cycle.
landingPage.openSourceDesc: MIT licensed and open for contributions. Built with modern tech stack: React 18, TypeScript, Spring Boot 3, Java 17+, shadcn/ui, and LangChain4j.

helpGuidesPage.title: Help & Guides
helpGuidesPage.subtitle: Learn how to make the most of ShipFlow with our comprehensive guides
helpGuidesPage.welcomeDesc: ShipFlow helps teams implement the Shape Up methodology for product development. These guides will help you understand and effectively use all features of the platform.
helpGuidesPage.tipText: New to ShipFlow? Start with "Getting Started with ShipFlow" to learn the fundamentals, then explore other guides based on your needs.
helpGuidesPage.interactiveTourDesc: Click the help icon in the header to start an interactive tour of the application.
helpGuidesPage.aiAssistantDesc: Use the floating Q&A button on any page to ask questions about your cycles and projects.
helpGuidesPage.gettingStartedDesc: Learn the basics of ShipFlow, from logging in to navigating the interface and understanding core concepts.
helpGuidesPage.hillChartsDesc: Master the hill chart visualization to track progress through the figuring-out and making-it-happen phases.
helpGuidesPage.bettingMeetingDesc: Step-by-step guide to conducting effective betting meetings and making informed cycle commitments.
helpGuidesPage.aiRiskAdvisorDesc: Leverage AI-powered risk assessments to identify potential issues and improve your planning.
helpGuidesPage.cycleSetupDesc: Complete walkthrough of creating a cycle, adding pitches, and managing your team's work.
helpGuidesPage.qaTestingDesc: Learn how to manage test cases, generate tests with AI, and track bugs.
helpGuidesPage.retrospectivesDesc: Run effective retrospectives to capture learnings and improve team processes.
helpGuidesPage.circuitBreakerDesc: Detect and respond to scope overflow using Shape Up's fixed-time safety valve.
helpGuidesPage.reportsDesc: Visualize metrics, track velocity, and create custom reporting dashboards.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started with ShipFlow
gettingStarted.subtitle: Learn the basics of ShipFlow and start managing your projects using the Shape Up methodology
gettingStarted.intro: ShipFlow is a project management tool built around the Shape Up methodology developed by Basecamp. It helps teams work in focused cycles, make informed betting decisions, and track progress through hill charts.
gettingStarted.shapeUpDesc: Shape Up is a product development methodology that emphasizes fixed time, variable scope, and small batch sizes. Teams work in 6-week cycles with 2-week cool-down periods.
gettingStarted.step1Item1: Navigate to the ShipFlow login page
gettingStarted.step1Item3: Click "Sign In" to access your workspace
gettingStarted.firstTimeDesc: Contact your administrator to get your login credentials.
gettingStarted.step2Subtitle: Your central hub for project insights
gettingStarted.step2Desc: After logging in, you'll land on the Dashboard. This is your command center where you can see:
gettingStarted.activeCyclesDesc: Current work cycles and their progress
gettingStarted.healthMetricsDesc: Overview of project health and risks
gettingStarted.step3Subtitle: Explore the main sections of ShipFlow
gettingStarted.step3Desc: The sidebar on the left contains all main navigation items organized into sections:
gettingStarted.projectsDesc: All your projects in one place
gettingStarted.step4Subtitle: Set up a project to organize your work
gettingStarted.step4Desc: Projects help you organize related cycles and pitches. Here's how to create one:
gettingStarted.step4Item1: Click on Projects in the sidebar
gettingStarted.step4Item3: Enter a project name and description
gettingStarted.step4Item4: Set a project key (e.g., "SHOP" for an e-commerce project)
gettingStarted.nextStepsDesc: Now that you're familiar with the basics, explore these guides:

retrospectives.title: Retrospectives
retrospectives.subtitle: Learn from every cycle and improve your team's process
retrospectives.cooldownDesc: In Shape Up, the cool-down period isn't just for bug fixes—it's for reflection. Retrospectives in ShipFlow are designed to capture what went well and what didn't while the memory is fresh.
retrospectives.requirementDesc: You must complete a retrospective before you can fully close a cycle in ShipFlow. This ensures continuous improvement is built into the process.
retrospectives.runningSubtitle: Setting up the board for your team
retrospectives.step3: Select the Cycle you just finished
retrospectives.step4: (Optional) Add initial notes or focus areas for the team
retrospectives.boardDesc: The retro board is divided into three standard columns. Team members can add cards with their name attached or submit anonymously for psychological safety.
retrospectives.anonymousDesc: When creating a retro item, check the "Post anonymously" checkbox to share feedback without attribution. This encourages honest, candid input on sensitive topics.
retrospectives.wentWellDesc: Successes, shout-outs, and things to keep doing.
retrospectives.actionItemsDesc: Concrete steps to take for the next cycle.
retrospectives.closingDesc: Once the discussion is done and action items are assigned:
retrospectives.closing2: Navigate back to the Cycle Detail page
retrospectives.closing3: You will now see the "Retrospective Completed" checkmark
retrospectives.closing4: You can now safely Close the Cycle

aiRiskAdvisor.title: Using AI Risk Advisor
aiRiskAdvisor.subtitle: Leverage AI-powered insights to identify risks and improve your planning
aiRiskAdvisor.whatTitle: What is the AI Risk Advisor?
aiRiskAdvisor.whatDesc: The **AI Risk Advisor** is an intelligent assistant that analyzes your pitches, cycles, and projects to identify potential risks, dependencies, and areas of concern before they become problems.
aiRiskAdvisor.howWorksDesc: The AI analyzes your pitch descriptions, scope items, historical data, and team capacity to provide contextual risk assessments and recommendations.
aiRiskAdvisor.whereTitle: Where to Find AI Risk Assessments
aiRiskAdvisor.pitchDetailDesc: View AI-generated risk assessments for individual pitches, including scope risks, technical complexity, and dependency warnings.
aiRiskAdvisor.cycleOverviewDesc: See aggregate risk scores and health metrics for entire cycles, helping you understand overall cycle health.
aiRiskAdvisor.bettingTableDesc: Risk indicators appear next to each pitch during betting meetings, helping inform your commitment decisions.
aiRiskAdvisor.qaPanelDesc: Ask the AI specific questions about risks, dependencies, or concerns using the floating Q&A button.
aiRiskAdvisor.screenshotAlt: AI Risk Advisor panel showing risk assessment and recommendations
aiRiskAdvisor.scoresIntro: The AI assigns risk scores on a scale, typically categorized as:
aiRiskAdvisor.lowRiskDesc: Well-defined scope, clear approach, no major dependencies. Proceed with confidence.
aiRiskAdvisor.mediumRiskDesc: Some uncertainties or dependencies identified. Review recommendations and consider mitigation strategies.
aiRiskAdvisor.highRiskDesc: Significant concerns about scope, complexity, or feasibility. May need reshaping or descoping.
aiRiskAdvisor.scopeRiskDesc: Vague or overly broad deliverables that lack clear boundaries.
aiRiskAdvisor.complexityRiskDesc: Technical challenges, unfamiliar technology, or architectural unknowns.
aiRiskAdvisor.dependencyRiskDesc: Reliance on external teams, APIs, or incomplete work from other pitches.
aiRiskAdvisor.capacityRiskDesc: Team overload, insufficient skillset, or timeline constraints.
aiRiskAdvisor.recommendation1: Read the full AI assessment to understand context
aiRiskAdvisor.recommendation2: Discuss flagged risks during pitch shaping or betting meetings
aiRiskAdvisor.recommendation3: Update pitch scope or appetites based on recommendations
aiRiskAdvisor.recommendation4: Mark risks as "acknowledged" or "mitigated" to track progress
aiRiskAdvisor.aiFindsItem1: Lack of specific metrics or success criteria
aiRiskAdvisor.aiFindsItem2: No mention of which parts of the dashboard
aiRiskAdvisor.aiFindsItem3: No appetite or scope boundaries defined
aiRiskAdvisor.aiSuggestsItem3: Break into Small Batch (1 week) vs Big Batch (6 weeks)
aiRiskAdvisor.qaDesc: Click the floating **Q&A** button (bottom right) to ask the AI specific questions about your work:
aiRiskAdvisor.qaExample1: "What are the biggest risks for Cycle 3?"
aiRiskAdvisor.qaExample3: "How risky is combining these two scopes?"
aiRiskAdvisor.qaNote: The AI will respond based on your project data and Shape Up best practices.
aiRiskAdvisor.feedbackDesc: Help improve AI accuracy by voting on recommendations:
aiRiskAdvisor.feedbackImpact: Your feedback trains the model for better future assessments.
aiRiskAdvisor.limitsSubtitle: What AI can and cannot do
aiRiskAdvisor.limitItem1: **AI is advisory:** It highlights potential issues but doesn't replace human judgment.
aiRiskAdvisor.limitItem2: **Garbage in, garbage out:** AI quality depends on clear, detailed pitch descriptions.
aiRiskAdvisor.limitItem3: **Update pitches:** If you reshape a pitch, re-run the AI analysis to get updated insights.
aiRiskAdvisor.limitItem4: **Not a blocker:** Risk flags are warnings, not hard stops. Teams can still bet on high-risk pitches if they accept the tradeoffs.

teamsIntegration.description: Configure Microsoft Teams workspace and channel-specific notification settings
teamsIntegration.confirmDeleteConfig: Are you sure you want to delete this Teams configuration?

teamsIntegration.tenantConfigurationDescription: Configure your primary Microsoft Teams integration. This will receive all notifications unless channel-specific webhooks are configured.
teamsIntegration.channelSettingsDescription: Configure notification preferences for specific channels. Each channel can have its own webhook and notification settings.
teamsIntegration.setupGuideDescription: Follow these steps to set up your Microsoft Teams integration:
teamsIntegration.step1Title: 1. Create an Incoming Webhook in Microsoft Teams
teamsIntegration.step1_1: Open Microsoft Teams and navigate to the channel where you want to receive notifications
teamsIntegration.step1_2: Click the three dots (...) next to the channel name and select "Connectors" or "Workflows" (depending on your Teams version)
teamsIntegration.step1_3: Search for "Incoming Webhook" and click "Add" or "Configure"
teamsIntegration.step1_4: Give your webhook a name (e.g., "ShipFlow") and optionally upload an icon
teamsIntegration.step1_5: Click "Create" and copy the webhook URL that is generated
teamsIntegration.step1_6: You'll use this URL when configuring your tenant below
teamsIntegration.step1_7: Click "Done" to complete the webhook setup in Teams
teamsIntegration.step2_2: Enter your organization/tenant name (this is just for your reference)
teamsIntegration.step2_3: Paste the webhook URL you copied from Teams
teamsIntegration.step2_4: Optionally specify a default channel name
teamsIntegration.step2_5: Enable or disable the integration as needed and click Save
teamsIntegration.step3_1: After setting up your tenant, switch to the "Channel Notifications" tab
teamsIntegration.step3_2: Click "Add Channel" to create a new channel configuration
teamsIntegration.step3_3: Enter the channel name and optionally a channel-specific webhook URL
teamsIntegration.step3_4: Choose which notification types to send to this channel (task assignments, completions, etc.)
teamsIntegration.multipleChannelsTip: Tip: You can create multiple channel configurations to route different notification types to different Teams channels. For example, send task assignments to #dev-team and cycle events to #announcements.
teamsIntegration.channelPreferences: If you don't specify a channel-specific webhook, notifications will use the tenant's default webhook and channel. You can customize notification preferences for each. Go to the "Channel Notifications" tab to add more channels.
teamsIntegration.notifyTaskAssigned: 📋 Task Assigned: When a task is assigned to a team member
teamsIntegration.notifyTaskCompleted: ✅ Task Completed: When a task is marked as complete
teamsIntegration.notifyTaskBlocked: 🚫 Task Blocked: When a task becomes blocked
teamsIntegration.notifyPitchShaped: 💡 Pitch Shaped: When a new pitch is fully shaped and ready
